Link with AudioToolbox, CoreAudio, CoreFoundation and libc++; do not link Apple's
OpenAL framework at the same time. Both app and test bundle must resolve AL calls
against the app's same library instance. Preserve source and license materials
with distribution and provide relinkable application objects when distributing
a statically linked binary under the library's license requirements.
